args.final_thought: Found a crashing PoC and submitted it successfully. The submitted candidate was `/tmp/TrueType_without_cmap.pdf`, which triggers an MSan use-of-uninitialized-value in FreeType during glyph loading via Poppler’s PDF rendering path.
